summary: @servicetitan/intl preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line, hex-identifier, rotated-string-array obfuscated bundle that is not referenced by the package's `main`/`exports`. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: the obfuscated payload is executed under a freshly fetched Bun binary rather than Node, so it is never loaded by Node-visible tooling on the installer host. The package presents itself as an internationalization library under the `@servicetitan` scope with a homepage at docs.st.dev, mimicking a first-party ServiceTitan intl module, but an i18n library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an opaque 727 KB blob at install time. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the developer or build machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
